professionalAndLeadership.longDescription: I spent the summer in Miri with the Mechanical, Materials and Integrity team, building data tools that help engineers keep corrosion in check across Shell's Sarawak fields.
highlights: Built a Corrosion Inhibitor (CI) daily monitoring tool that replaced a manual reporting routine, saving engineers about 10 hours a week, plus SCIM, a Power BI dashboard that shows fleet-wide CI performance at a glance.

Developed ADEPT (Adaptive Data Estimation with Predictive Training), a machine learning model that uses Integrity Operating Window (IOW) data to optimise CI target dosages across 15 Sarawakian fields.
Delivered the MMI-PC IOW dashboard with the Process Chemistry team, bringing sampled IOW data into one shared view for both teams.

Supported Risk-Based Inspection by reconciling five years of piping inspection reports against the piping masterlists, aligning CMLs to a new naming convention and converting 70 long-term composite repair records.

Presented the CI tool at the Virtual Mechanical Engineering Conference (VMEC) 2026 and to the SCL Leadership Team, and wrote the documentation the team needs to run and extend all three tools after handover.

professionalAndLeadership.longDescription: Two months in Arup's London office, on the project team for a specialist plant collection and research facility, two prominent London museums and a premium lab space.
highlights: Designed condensate routing options for Mechanical Ventilation Heat Recovery (MVHR) units in Dalux.
Ran pressure duct calculations for MVHR intake and extract air to size ductwork in BIM and Revit.
Scheduled areas on updated architect floor plans in Bluebeam Revu, classifying rooms by type, conditioning strategy and AHU service for other engineers' calculations.
Carried out ventilation and louvre sizing calculations, and embodied carbon calculations for Fan Coil Unit (FCU) servicing options using Arup's in-house workflow tool.

professionalAndLeadership.longDescription: I started SSI at the end of 2021 to show promising young Sarawakians what's possible after secondary school, and how to get there through the scholarships, loans and sponsorships many never hear about. What began as a central hub for post-secondary pathways and financial aid applications has grown, through years of grassroots work, into a youth organisation focused on access, advocacy and equality for every Sarawakian student.

milestones.text: A week of online scholarship talks with speakers from different scholarships and pre-university pathways, drawing over 100 participants.
Sarawak Education Outreach Roadshow in Kuching, Sibu, Miri and Bintulu.
Roadshow in Kuching, Kota Samarahan and Miri, providing transport so rural schools could attend. Rural Outreach Roadshow at MRSM Betong.
Roadshow in Kuching, Sibu and Bintulu. Officially registered as a youth organisation (Kelab Belia) under the Ministry of Youth and Sports Malaysia — PPBM: KT17276/13/25.

professionalAndLeadership.role: Sergeant, Band Major and NCO Council Chairman
professionalAndLeadership.longDescription: Twelve years in the Boys' Brigade, from weekly parades to leading the council. I organised weekly meetings with drill, camping, first aid and cooking, ran band training and led the percussion, woodwind and brass sections at performances, and as NCO Council Chairman oversaw our Band, Drill, Fun and Leadership Camps.
